      public ProjectService(cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.dao.repository.ProjectRepository projectRepository, cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.dao.repository.TeamRepository teamRepository, cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.dao.repository.AnnotationRepository annotationRepository, cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.dao.repository.LabelRepository labelRepository, StorageManager storageManager, ProjectMapper projectMapper, TeamMapper teamMapper, LabelMapper labelMapper, AnnotationMapper annotationMapper, FileSystemService fileSystemService, ProgressMapper progressMapper, PriorityMapper priorityMapper, AIClient aiClient)
      Constructor for ProjectService.
      Parameters:
      projectRepository - the ProjectRepository instance to use for fetching and saving projects
      teamRepository - the TeamRepository instance to use for fetching teams
      annotationRepository - the AnnotationRepository instance to use for managing annotations
      labelRepository - the LabelRepository instance to use for managing labels
      storageManager - the StorageManager instance to use for file storage operations
      projectMapper - the ProjectMapper instance to map between ProjectEntity and Project
      teamMapper - the TeamMapper instance to map between TeamEntity and Team
      labelMapper - the LabelMapper instance to map between LabelEntity and Label
      annotationMapper - the AnnotationMapper instance to map between AnnotationEntity and Annotation
      fileSystemService - the FileSystemService instance to manage file system operations
      progressMapper - the ProgressMapper instance to map between ProgressEnum and Progress
      priorityMapper - the PriorityMapper instance to map between PriorityEnum and Priority
      aiClient - the AIClient instance to interact with AI services
